# Solvex Tourist Agency

> Solvex is a tourist agency operating on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast. This website is a catalog of excursions and a directory of local tour representatives for foreign tourists visiting Bulgaria. Tourists access the site by scanning QR codes placed at hotel receptions.

## Language support

The site is available in English (en), Romanian (ro), Russian (ru), and Ukrainian (uk). Append `?lang=ro` (or ru / uk) to any URL to retrieve content in that language.

## Main sections

- [Home](/) — Overview of the agency's excursions and services
- [Excursions](/excursions) — Full catalog of tours with prices, departure dates, and departure resorts
- [Resorts](/resorts) — Informational pages about Black Sea resorts where the agency operates (Nessebar, Sunny Beach, Sozopol, etc.)
- [Representatives](/representatives) — Contact directory of local tour guides and representatives, including phone, WhatsApp, languages spoken, and hotels served
- [Useful Info](/useful-info) — Practical travel tips and resort-specific information for tourists

## Booking

Tourists can reserve excursions directly on the site. Payments are processed via Revolut. After booking, tourists receive a confirmation reference number and can pay online or on-site.

## Public API

A REST API is available at `/api` (JSON):
- `GET /api/excursions` — list of excursions (supports `?lang=`, `?resortId=`, `?q=` search)
- `GET /api/excursions/{id}` — excursion detail with photos and departure info
- `GET /api/resorts` — list of resorts
- `GET /api/resorts/{id}` — resort detail with photos
- `GET /api/representatives` — list of representatives (supports `?resortId=`, `?language=`)
- `GET /api/sitemap.xml` — XML sitemap with all public URLs
